resale_co.name: Certificate of Construction Records Clearance (CRC)
resale_co.issued_by: Township of Long Hill Construction Office (Construction Official)
resale_co.lead_time: Submit the application and fee at least 10 business days before the change of ownership (ordinance); the form charges more when filed under 7 business days.
requirements: No open construction permits on the property; if permits are open, all final inspections and approvals must be completed and UCC certificates issued first
Application lists property, closing date (required), seller/agent, block and lot and property type
Exempt (if no change in physical occupancy): deed corrections, ancient deeds, spouse/former spouse transfers, new construction with a CO, estate distributions, refinancing, receivers/trustees

fees.label: Construction Records Clearance, filed more than 7 business days before closing
fees.quote: APPLICATION FEE: $50 OVER 7 BUSINESS DAYS or $100 UNDER 7 BUSINESS DAYS

fees.label: Construction Records Clearance, filed under 7 business days before closing
fees.quote: APPLICATION FEE: $50 OVER 7 BUSINESS DAYS or $100 UNDER 7 BUSINESS DAYS

resale_co.how_to_apply: Submit the Construction Records Clearance Application to the Construction Office at Town Hall, 915 Valley Road, with exact cash or a check payable to Long Hill Township. The first point of contact is the Technical Assistant (construction@longhillnj.gov, 908-647-8000 ext. 217).
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Code Official / Building Subcode Official (ext. 216)

evidence.quote: A CRC shall be required prior to the sale of any residential or commercial structure and prior to the rental of any tenant space in a commercial structure within the Township.
A CRC shall be issued if, but only if, there are no open construction permits on the premises.

The owner or his authorized agent shall submit a written application and payment of fees at least 10 business days prior to the change of ownership and/or occupancy on the form available from the Construction Office.
APPLICATION FEE: $50 OVER 7 BUSINESS DAYS or $100 UNDER 7 BUSINESS DAYS

resale_co.notes: Long Hill does not run a full resale housing inspection. Since Ordinance 543-24 (August 14, 2024), Section 29-3 requires a Construction Records Clearance certificate (a records check for open permits) before any residential sale; fees are set by resolution and the Township form charges $50 when filed more than 7 business days ahead or $100 under 7 business days. The CRC form is a scanned image PDF, so its fee quote cannot be text-matched. Section LU-105.3 applies certificates of continued occupancy only to non-residential uses, and the Planning and Zoning page says a Zoning Permit / Certificate of Continued Compliance ($75.00) is required for change of tenancy (rental), not sales. The Fire Official's sale inspection also checks sump pump discharge (see other items). Construction contact names are from the Construction Department page.

requirements: Smoke alarms: basement at bottom of stairs, each floor at the stairs, and within 10 feet of any bedroom/sleeping area on each level (UL listed); battery alarms must be 10-year sealed units
Carbon monoxide alarms inside and/or outside sleeping areas, in the hallway within 10 feet of bedroom doors, and in any finished basement or recreation area
Existing hardwired or wireless interconnected fire alarm systems maintained to original level
Secondary power source label within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and meter (P.L. 2025, c.19), if applicable
Sump pump discharge not connected to the sanitary waste line
House number in numerals at least 3 inches high, matching tax records
Portable fire extinguisher no longer required for home sales (still required for rentals)

authorities.name: Long Hill Township Fire Prevention (Office of the Fire Official)
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days between the completed application and closing: more than 10 business days for the lowest fee. Appointments are based on availability. Certificates are valid for 6 months from issue.

fees.label: Certificate of Inspection, application received more than 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: INSPECTION REQUESTS RECEIVED 10 or more business days prior to closing/tenant turnover = $100.

fees.label: Certificate of Inspection, 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: INSPECTION REQUESTS RECEIVED 4-10 business days prior to closing/tenant turnover = $140.

fees.label: Certificate of Inspection, 4 business days or less before closing
fees.quote: INSPECTION REQUESTS RECEIVED 4 business days or less prior to closing/tenant turnover = $211.

fees.label: Reinspection after failed inspection (10+ day tier)
fees.quote: Reinspection fee following an unsuccessful initial inspection = $25.

fees.label: Reinspection after failed inspection (4-10 day tier)
fees.quote: Reinspection fee following an unsuccessful initial inspection = $50.

fees.label: Reinspection after failed inspection (4 days or less tier)
fees.quote: Reinspection fee following an unsuccessful initial inspection = $100.

fees.label: No-show for a scheduled appointment
fees.quote: No-show for a scheduled appointment = $50 reinspection fee

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete the 'Application for Home Sale/Change in Tenancy Certificate of Inspection' and submit it with payment to "Township of Long Hill", ATTN: Fire Official, 915 Valley Road, Gillette (by mail with a check, or in person with cash, check or credit card; card payments carry a convenience fee). Test all alarms before the inspection.

evidence.quote: Change in Tenancy Certificate of Inspection
- Portable fire extinguisher no longer required for home sales only -
For further information or assistance, please contact the Fire Official at fireofficial@longhillnj.gov or call (908) 647-8000, Ext 307.
INSPECTION REQUESTS RECEIVED 10 or more business days prior to closing/tenant turnover =
Upon satisfactory completion of inspection, a certificate will be issued. Certificates are valid for 6 months from date of issue.
If you have any further questions, please contact the Fire Official, Don Huber, (908) 647-8000,

fire_cert.notes: Long Hill's Fire Official runs the sale inspection (smoke, CO, secondary power label, sump pump). The current application (Rev. 07/2026) and the guidelines both show $100 / $140 / $211 tiers; the guidelines give tiered reinspection fees ($25 / $50 / $100) while the application shows a flat $25 reinspection and $50 no-show. The application and guidelines both say a portable fire extinguisher is no longer required for home sales, in line with P.L.2025, c.19. An older 'Application for Certificate for Resale of Residential Property Only - NO PERMITTED OCCUPANCY' form (Rev. 08/2024, same fee tiers) is also posted for sales where the buyer will not occupy. The NJ DCA LEA registry code for Long Hill is M; the state directory lists the township (Municipal) as enforcing agency with Fire Official Donald M Huber.

other_items.label: Sump pump discharge check
other_items.detail: The Fire Official's sale inspection verifies sump pump discharge lines are not connected to the sanitary waste line.

other_items.label: House numbers
other_items.detail: House numbers must be in numerals at least three inches high and match tax records (Chapter 29-2.5).

other_items.label: Resale certificate without occupancy
other_items.detail: A separate resale-only fire certificate with no permitted occupancy is available (same $100 / $140 / $211 tiers) when the buyer will not move in right away.

open_questions: Is the CRC fee still $50 / $100 by resolution, and how long is a CRC valid?
Which reinspection fee applies: flat $25 (application) or tiered $25 / $50 / $100 (guidelines)?
